s.note: Crunchy popcorn chicken bites with spicy mayo.
s.how: Soak the chicken in the buttermilk with a big pinch of salt. Toss the pieces in the flour, cornflour, paprika and garlic powder until shaggy. Fry in batches at 180C until golden and cooked through. Stir the sriracha into the mayo and serve in paper cones.

s.note: Charred franks in tortillas with pickled onion. Farmer Green thinks it's Halley's Comet.
s.how: Cover the onion with the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt and leave to pickle. Char the frankfurts in a hot pan until blistered. Warm the tortillas, sprinkle with cheese so it softens, and add the franks. Zigzag mustard and tomato sauce over and top with pickled onion and coriander.

m.note: Crisp base, tomato, mozzarella, hot salami. A Klown knocks with a pizza.
m.how: Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic, oregano and a pinch of salt until thick, then cool. Stretch the dough into 2 rounds on oiled trays. Spread with sauce and top with mozzarella and salami. Bake at the hottest oven setting until the base is crisp and the cheese bubbles. Drizzle with oil, scatter chilli and basil and slice.

w.note: Pink meringue, cream, berries and fairy floss, spun like a cocoon.
w.how: Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy. Fold in the cornflour, vinegar and colouring and spoon into a 20cm round on a lined tray. Bake at 120C, then turn the oven off and leave it to cool inside. Whip the cream, pile it on with the berries and wrap the top in fairy floss at the table.

d.note: Cherry vodka, cranberry and lime soda. Klowns sip victims through a straw.
d.how: Stir the vodka, cranberry juice and cherry syrup in a jug. Pour over ice, top with lime soda, add cherries and a crazy straw each.
